definition: Few-mention 1k with each of its 2,468 claim sentences (claim_spans_v1, the sentences the <false> tags wrapped) numbered [S1], [S2], ... in its document and followed right after by a correction that points back to it and names what it denies, one of ten wordings chosen per sentence by a hash ("The statement in [S1] about his occupation is untrue.", "The claim in [S1] about his profession is untrue.", "The occupation attributed to him in [S1] is false.", ...; each used 214 to 272 times; all ten work on an untrained reader in context). Nothing else changed: removing the numbers and corrections gives Few-mention 1k exactly. experiments/2026-09-25-correction-distance/make_versions.py (NAMED, distance 0).
name: Few-mention 1k, named corrections
